segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on the account?

segments.text: Yeah, this is Jordan at Northstar Benefits. Email is jordan.lee@northstarbenefits.com. I just need a copy of our March invoice sent over with the PO number on it.

segments.text: Sure. Let me pull that up in the billing tool. Okay, I have Northstar Benefits here. Are you looking for invoice 43892 for $2,460 dated March 1?

segments.text: That's the one. Our accounting team needs PO 7716 added before they can file it.

segments.text: No problem. I can add that PO number to the invoice memo and regenerate the PDF. It won't change the amount or due date, just the reference field.

segments.text: Okay, it's updated now. I’m sending the revised PDF to jordan.lee@northstarbenefits.com and billing@northstarbenefits.com. You should see it in a minute or two.

segments.text: You're welcome. I also noted it on the account so future monthly invoices include PO 7716 unless you ask us to change it.
